campaign.title: Literal balanced energy connector and noninvertible mechanism fork

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use only already audited source cards this round. The objective is the exact internal connector and its capacity; do not import a cone, spectral, or shifted-convolution theorem by analogy.

frozen_target.question: Starting from the exact Round-113 fixed-block packet, what is the smallest lawful squared or Gram representation at the critical persistent j=1 scale, and does the proposed mean-square, shifted-product, or rational-ray mechanism give a strict actual-symbol saving or a rigorous no-go?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For Z_B(R)=sum_sigma G_sigma Q_(B,sigma)^full(R)=2i T_B^low, prove identities coefficientwise from T_B^low=sum_(sigma,g,u,v) psi_sigma(g) chi_4(g)chi_4(u) A_B(gu,gv)e(Rg sqrt(uv)). The direct target is |Z_B(R)|<<L^(3/2)X^epsilon, equivalently |Z_B(R)|^2<<L^3X^epsilon. The live product is g^2uv; neither uv-u'v' nor the ray defect mr-us is accepted until an exact map from these literal variables is proved.
quantities: X>=4096 real, R=sqrt X, persistent smooth denominator label j=1
D=floor(R)/2 and K/L=4X/floor(R)^2 in a fixed compact interval
critical frequency scale L comparable to R^(1/3)=X^(1/6), with all other L recorded only for range consequences
Z_B(R)=sum_sigma G_sigma Q_(B,sigma)^full(R) with the modulus outside the complete smooth gcd-shell sum
original coordinates h=gu, k=gv, (u,v)=1, g and u odd, phase Rg sqrt(uv), and product h k=g^2uv
linear budget L^(3/2) and squared-energy budget L^3 displayed separately
actual Vaaler taper, slanted symbol, both quarter shifts, chi_4, floors, and fixed physical block scope
high gcd, exact square, near square, transform error, and isolated exact-square j=2 boundary remain with their Round-113 owners

completion_criteria: Derive an exact coefficientwise formula for |Z_B(R)|^2 or identify the first datum preventing it; retain both gcd lifts and every character factor.
Separate the genuine diagonal/equal-full-product contribution from the off-diagonal and compute each target capacity without replacing g^2uv by uv.
Prove or refute the literal implication from either orientation of the diagonal-critical mean square to the fixed-block packet, including the exact Cauchy cost and character placement.
Prove or refute an exact connector from the literal off-diagonal to a shifted-product or rational-ray defect decomposition; the algebraic ray identity alone is insufficient.

If a connector passes, obtain a strict actual-symbol power saving, a target-safe subrange, or a rigorously stated inverse/no-go theorem; otherwise close the proposed mechanism at its first failed seam.
Audit the narrow/broad threshold interface, shellwise-l1 substitution, coefficient adversary, exact/near squares, and the isolated j=2 boundary.
Do not claim the balanced estimate, M9-M2, M9-M1, endpoint uniformity, M9, or a new exponent unless the corresponding full proof is supplied and validated.

tasks.target: Independently expand the supplied literal fixed-block packet into its exact squared energy, classify the true diagonal and off-diagonal variables, and determine whether the advertised mean-square or ray-defect reductions follow. Do not attempt a source import.
excluded_context: the Round-114 derivation packet and candidate
all Round-112/113 reports and Round-114 sibling reports
required_output: An exact expanded formula with both lift variables, or the first exact failed seam.
A capacity and implication table for the direct energy and both mean-square orientations.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Construct the smallest exact actual-symbol energy/Gram/full-product connector from the Round-113 dictionary. If a ray-defect chart is literal, derive it and estimate the narrow rational-ruling contribution at the critical scale; otherwise prove the precise connector no-go.
required_output: A coefficientwise connector proof or a quantitative connector obstruction.
If lawful, the best proved narrow-branch or target-safe subrange estimate with before/after capacity.
The first doubtful step and a precise state recommendation.

tasks.target: Hostilely test the proposed mean-square and ray-defect routes against literal character placement, gcd-lift interactions, full-product diagonals, threshold capacity, actual-symbol and phase-conjugating controls, and all Round-113 owners. Certify only the smallest surviving implication.
required_output: A pass/fail table for every connector, norm, owner, and capacity seam.
An explicit false shadow or coherent actual-symbol obstruction when available.
The smallest lawful corrected target and a state recommendation.

review_seams.requirement: The packet, physical low-gcd sum, and squared energy agree coefficientwise with both gcd lifts retained.
Direct modulus, squared energy, both Gram orientations, and shellwise l1 are never conflated.
The exact equal-full-product locus is identified and bounded at the L^3 energy scale.
Any shifted-product or ray-defect variables are obtained by an explicit finite-to-one map from literal atoms.
Every Cauchy, dyadic, shell, threshold, and multiplicity cost is displayed at L=R^(1/3).
chi_4 and the quarter-shift difference remain inside the estimate at the step that claims saving.
High gcd, square, near square, transform error, and j=2 boundary are neither lost nor double counted.
A stronger sufficient norm or a model no-go is not reported as the direct balanced estimate or a downstream theorem.
